proposal.patch:
diff --git a/slug.py b/slug.py
--- a/slug.py
+++ b/slug.py
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 def slugify(value: str) -> str:
-    return value.strip().lower().replace(" ", "-")
+    return "-".join(value.strip().lower().split())
plan: Replace literal-space replacement with whitespace-run collapsing by splitting on arbitrary whitespace and joining on a single hyphen.
Keep lowercase conversion and trimming behavior intact.
proposal.summary: Update slugify to collapse any whitespace run into one hyphen while preserving lowercase output.
